mapper.select: SELECT a.id , a.title , a.content , b.name as category_name , a.created_at , a.created_by , a.modified_at , a.modified_by , c.name AS created_by_name , d.name AS modified_by_name FROM post a LEFT JOIN category b ON a.category_id = b.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER c ON a.created_by = c.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER d ON a.modified_by = d.id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND (UPPER(a.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') OR UPPER(a.content) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') OR UPPER(b.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%'))

SELECT a.id , a.title , a.content , b.name AS category_name , a.created_at , a.modified_at , c.name AS created_by_name , d.name AS modified_by_name FROM post a LEFT JOIN category b ON a.category_id = b.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER c ON a.created_by = c.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER d ON a.modified_by = d.id WHERE a.id = #{postId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT a.id , a.title , a.content , b.name AS category_name , a.created_at , a.modified_at , c.name AS created_by_name , d.name AS modified_by_name FROM post a LEFT JOIN category b ON a.category_id = b.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER c ON a.created_by = c.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER d ON a.modified_by = d.id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT a.id , a.title , a.content , b.name AS category_name , a.created_at , a.modified_at , c.name AS created_by_name , d.name AS modified_by_name FROM post a LEFT JOIN category b ON a.category_id = b.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER c ON a.created_by = c.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER d ON a.modified_by = d.id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND c.username = #{currentUserName}
